labels.label: bzprop:c3s2p5_balayable_somme
labels.notes: Sphere.prop5_balayable_somme (BalayableSommeProp5.lean:164) carries Prop. 4's hypotheses as prop4_produit does: IsConvexPart, IsOpen, Nonempty, noyau = ∅, plus the disclosed added ¬ ContientDroite (F w) (OQ-168). It is universally quantified over every enumeration l : Fin (q+1) ≃ simplesS w, every n and every bases b, and it gives BOTH iff's (balayable and homogène) between w (as Opens of S(m)) and every B_i = ofCone(b_i '' val⁻¹' sommandeS w (l i)). Since F(composanteS w L) = sommandeS w L (prop4_somme), B_i is s(b_i(F(v_i))) for the paper's v_i. Not vacuous: under Hyps4, prop4_somme gives simplesS w finite with ncard ≥ 1, so an enumeration Fin (q+1) ≃ simplesS w exists, and bases exist (exists_bases_simplesS). The quantification over every choice makes the Lean at least the paper under OQ-171's reading. Unmarked: the docstring names the label in plain backticks with 'NOT marked', and REPORT gives status partial, which is correct because it depends on OQ-168 and OQ-171, both OPEN. The checklist and SCOPE are present and accurate. Findings checked: (1) Ch. 1 § 3 Prop. 4 (homogeneous_of_compatible_pi / balayable_of_compatible_pi) gives only ⇒, and ⇐ needs Prop. 3 (isHomogeneous_piBase / isBalayable_piBase, ProductsGeneral.lean) plus transport. That is a true omitted citation, correctly not worded as a falsity. (2) The inherited missing hypothesis is honestly disclosed, and no unsupported claim about Prop. 5 without it is made. Invariance lemmas IsProjIso.isHomogeneous_iff / isBalayable_iff: kernel-checked and not vacuous, since IsProjIso is inhabited (IsProjIso.refl, and the Ψ of prop4_produit to which they are applied). Instances simplexO_prop5 and simplexO_isHomogeneous are real theorems (not hypotheses) with standard axioms. simplexO_isHomogeneous uses the ⇐ direction substantively. Side remark, not the closer's fault: the OQ-171 row text in registers/DECISIONS.md still says prop4_produit is 'stated in the scaffold on one tagged sorry', but it is now proved with no sorry in strict Benzecri/Chapter3/BalayableSommeProduit.lean.
